name: Morph V3 Large
title: Morph V3 Large: price, context window and specs
answer: Morph V3 Large is a model in Morph's Morph family, first listed on 2025-07-07. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 262K tokens and up to 131K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.9 per million input tokens and $1.9 per million output tokens. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the newest of the 2 versions of Morph listed today.
Its input price is the family median, $0.9 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
